caption:
Before the Day Begins

I work across many countries and cities.
At times, I am in a different city every week —
and some mornings, I wake up
not quite sure where I am.

So for about ten years now,
I have kept one thing the same:
yoga, every morning, even when I travel.
It keeps my focus steady, wherever I am.

Makeup can work the same way.

The same steps, every morning before work,
quietly settle the mind
and sharpen your focus.

So perhaps makeup is not only about beauty.
Why not let it be your switch —
a small ritual before the day begins?
